nodes.label: Servidor estatico para probar el build web. Existe porque `python -m…

nodes.label: sqflite_common (API pura, compila para web)
nodes.rationale: Engine-less API used by repositories; the only one importable from code that also compiles for web.

nodes.label: app/providers.dart (unico cableado de contratos)
nodes.rationale: Only file that knows both layers; decides which concrete implementation fulfills each contract.

nodes.label: Arquitectura en capas Widget -> Controlador -> Repositorio -> SQLite
nodes.norm_label: arquitectura en capas widget -> controlador -> repositorio -> sqlite
nodes.rationale: Each layer talks only to its neighbor, inward; presentation knows domain contracts, never implementations. Proven when adding the email account only touched data/.

nodes.label: No es facturacion electronica SUNAT
nodes.rationale: Internal documentation only; the accountant files it at month end.

nodes.label: Before/After Photo Evidence (Como llego / Como quedo)
nodes.norm_label: before/after photo evidence (como llego / como quedo)
nodes.rationale: Photos of how the equipment arrived and how it was left back up the work if the customer files a claim; capture is prompted while the equipment is in front of the technician, but the step is skippable.

nodes.label: 6-Step Repair Wizard with Segmented Progress Bar
nodes.norm_label: 6-step repair wizard with segmented progress bar
nodes.rationale: Header shows 'Paso 2 de 6' plus the record code, with close (X), back arrow and a primary 'Siguiente' button pinned to the bottom for one-handed use.

nodes.label: On-Device Data Counts (Registros, Repuestos, Recordatorios, Fotos)
nodes.norm_label: on-device data counts (registros, repuestos, recordatorios, fotos)

nodes.label: Restaurar desde un Archivo (Replace-All Restore)
nodes.rationale: Restore replaces everything on the device; intended for setting up a new phone, not merging two devices, which avoids conflict resolution logic.

nodes.label: Guardar Respaldo via Share Sheet (Drive/WhatsApp)
nodes.rationale: All data lives only on the phone, so the backup file is handed to the OS share sheet so the user sends it off-device (Drive or WhatsApp) instead of relying on a cloud backend.

nodes.label: Servicios MS Brand Header (maroon/gold, multimeter logo)
nodes.norm_label: servicios ms brand header (maroon/gold, multimeter logo)

nodes.label: Screenshot: Login with Linked Email Account
nodes.norm_label: screenshot: login with linked email account

nodes.label: Screenshot: Login Rejected by Email Account
nodes.norm_label: screenshot: login rejected by email account

nodes.label: Seguir sin el Correo (Offline Fallback)
nodes.rationale: When the remote email account rejects the password (e.g. it was changed via the reset link), the user is told to use the new password but is also offered a path to continue without the email account, so a remote auth mismatch never locks the owner out of local data.

nodes.label: Linux CMake project (BINARY_NAME taller_repuestos, APPLICATION_ID com.example.taller_repuestos)
nodes.norm_label: linux cmake project (binary_name taller_repuestos, application_id com.example.taller_repuestos)

nodes.label: Pendiente: respaldo automatico en la nube (Cloud Storage requiere Blaze)
nodes.norm_label: pendiente: respaldo automatico en la nube (cloud storage requiere blaze)

nodes.label: Respaldo ZIP (datos.json + fotos/<id>.jpg)
nodes.rationale: Covers phone loss without server, account or cost. ZIP instead of DB copy because it can be opened and inspected without the app. Password never travels in the backup.

nodes.label: Fotos en tabla propia con bytes crudos y miniatura ~8KB
nodes.norm_label: fotos en tabla propia con bytes crudos y miniatura ~8kb
nodes.rationale: Base64 inside the record inflated files 33%; history now loads only a small thumbnail instead of full JPEG for a 50px row.

nodes.label: Migraciones que miran antes de tocar
nodes.norm_label: migraciones que miran antes de tocar
nodes.rationale: Until schema v4 the phone opened the DB without migrating, so some DBs claim version 1 but contain most tables; each step checks column/table existence and tests open faithful copies.

nodes.label: Restaurar reemplaza, no mezcla
nodes.rationale: Merging two histories with their own correlatives would duplicate document codes.

nodes.label: Build APK release (Kotlin incremental desactivado en Windows)
nodes.norm_label: build apk release (kotlin incremental desactivado en windows)
nodes.rationale: android/gradle.properties disables Kotlin incremental compilation because the build fails with 'Could not close incremental caches'. Signed with debug key, not Play Store ready.

nodes.label: Recuperacion de contrasena por correo (Firebase Auth plan Spark)
nodes.norm_label: recuperacion de contrasena por correo (firebase auth plan spark)
nodes.rationale: Free plan, no card, no Firestore/Storage. google-services.json not versioned because repo is public; app still builds without it, just without email recovery.

nodes.label: Escritorio de Windows no es destino
nodes.norm_label: escritorio de windows no es destino
nodes.rationale: With Firebase in the project, a Windows build downloads the Firebase C++ SDK; use the phone or Chrome instead.

nodes.label: Masked Account Email (wi••••••@gmail.com)
nodes.rationale: Login shows the linked account read-only and partially masked so the owner recognizes it without exposing the full address on the lock screen.

nodes.label: Home Shell (Hoy Toca carousel, Historial list, bottom nav, FAB)
nodes.norm_label: home shell (hoy toca carousel, historial list, bottom nav, fab)
nodes.rationale: Top bar shows business name and RUC with logo; a 'Hoy toca' reminder card surfaces today's due maintenance; bottom nav Historial/Inventario/Avisos with badge and a central + FAB for new records.

nodes.label: Vincular Correo (Email + App Password Confirmation)
nodes.rationale: Linking an email for password recovery requires re-entering the current app password, so a recovery channel cannot be attached by someone holding an unlocked phone.

nodes.label: Screenshot: Recuperacion por Correo Dialog (Link Email)
nodes.norm_label: screenshot: recuperacion por correo dialog (link email)

nodes.label: Screenshot: Email Dialog Blocked by Factory Password
nodes.norm_label: screenshot: email dialog blocked by factory password

nodes.label: Factory Default Password Guard
nodes.rationale: The factory password is printed in the app instructions, so an email account created with it could be opened by anyone; the dialog refuses to link email until the password is changed and offers a 'Cambiar contrasena' CTA.

nodes.label: Repair Shop / Parts Business Brand Identity
nodes.norm_label: repair shop / parts business brand identity

nodes.label: Dos boletas separadas suman igual que la junta
nodes.norm_label: dos boletas separadas suman igual que la junta
nodes.rationale: Discount and tax of the second boleta are computed by difference so totals and IGV match exactly.

nodes.label: IGV 18% incluido en los precios
nodes.rationale: IGV is not added on top; it is broken out of the total only for display. Client pays sum of lines minus discount.

nodes.label: Traslado solo en campo y con movilidad propia
nodes.norm_label: traslado solo en campo y con movilidad propia

nodes.label: Roll-up metal shutter background
nodes.rationale: Dark ribbed backdrop evokes a workshop roll-up door, reinforcing the electrician/mechanic context; gold accent line at bottom suggests a loading/progress bar.

nodes.label: MS logo spark reveal animation
nodes.rationale: Gold 'MS' letters revealed by a welding-spark highlight give a workshop-themed brand intro before the app loads.

nodes.label: Floating bottom nav with central + FAB (Historial/Inventario/Avisos)
nodes.norm_label: floating bottom nav with central + fab (historial/inventario/avisos)
nodes.rationale: Dark pill nav with gold active indicator; Avisos tab carries a count badge; central maroon/gold + button is the primary create action.

nodes.label: Business header bar (Servicios MS, RUC, logo)
nodes.norm_label: business header bar (servicios ms, ruc, logo)
nodes.rationale: Shared top bar across main tabs shows business identity (name, RUC, logo) plus a store button to open the business profile.

nodes.label: Hoy toca reminder carousel
nodes.rationale: Hero card surfaces today's due reminder (client + task) at the top of the job history, with page dots and '+1 mas' to reach other due items.

nodes.label: Buscar cliente o equipo search with filter button
nodes.norm_label: buscar cliente o equipo search with filter button

nodes.label: Service job list (client, equipment, date, S/ total)
nodes.norm_label: service job list (client, equipment, date, s/ total)
nodes.rationale: Each row shows initial avatar, client, equipment or sale type, date and total in soles, with an overflow menu; includes a direct parts sale (Ferreteria Sur).

nodes.label: Cliente y equipo form (step 1)
nodes.rationale: Captures client, equipment, model/serial and date; subtitle states these data are printed on the report and the boleta.

nodes.label: Facturar a (bill-to override) field
nodes.rationale: Optional; when empty the client name is used for billing.

nodes.label: 6-step segmented progress indicator
nodes.rationale: Job registration split into 6 short steps (Paso 1 de 6) with close button and sticky Siguiente CTA to keep each screen simple for a non-technical user.

nodes.label: Business profile fields (RUC, Direccion, Telefono, Email)
nodes.norm_label: business profile fields (ruc, direccion, telefono, email)
nodes.rationale: Read-only key/value list with a sticky Editar datos button leading to the edit form.

nodes.label: Asi sale en el documento header preview
nodes.norm_label: asi sale en el documento header preview
nodes.rationale: Live preview of how the business letterhead (logo, name, RUC, address, phone, email) will appear on generated documents.

nodes.label: Recurrence chip (3 m)
nodes.rationale: Indicates a repeating maintenance reminder (every 3 months), e.g. compressor filter change.

nodes.norm_label: spare part list (name, stock, price, delete)
nodes.rationale: Simple parts catalog (Faja A-52, Filtro de aceite, Rodamiento 6205) with unit price in soles and a Nuevo repuesto button.

nodes.label: Flutter Default Logo Artwork (iOS App Icon)
nodes.norm_label: flutter default logo artwork (ios app icon)
nodes.rationale: All iOS AppIcon PNGs show the stock Flutter 'F' chevron logo (light/mid/dark blue on white) generated by `flutter create`; the taller_repuestos app has not been rebranded with a custom iOS icon.

nodes.label: Transparent 1x1 Launch Image Placeholder
nodes.rationale: Each LaunchImage variant is a 68-byte blank/transparent PNG from the Flutter template; the iOS launch screen shows no custom splash artwork.

nodes.label: History list with search and filter chips (Todos/Pendientes/Completados)
nodes.norm_label: history list with search and filter chips (todos/pendientes/completados)

nodes.label: Repuestos usados (parts search with QR scan, qty stepper)
nodes.norm_label: repuestos usados (parts search with qr scan, qty stepper)
nodes.rationale: Parts are picked from inventory with price prefilled; if inventory is empty the user can still type a part name, creating an 'Externo' (non-inventory) part.

nodes.label: Trabajo realizado line (labor charged at agreed price, no quantity)
nodes.norm_label: trabajo realizado line (labor charged at agreed price, no quantity)
nodes.rationale: Labor is billed as a flat agreed price rather than quantity x unit price, simplifying entry for the technician.

nodes.norm_label: main shell (header with business name/ruc, bottom nav historial/inventario/+/avisos)

nodes.norm_label: record type: venta de repuestos (parts-only sale)

nodes.label: Record actions sheet (Ver documento, Seguir cargando, Descargar PDF)
nodes.norm_label: record actions sheet (ver documento, seguir cargando, descargar pdf)
nodes.rationale: An unclosed ('Sin cerrar') record offers resuming the wizard alongside viewing/exporting its document.

nodes.label: Historial home with Sin stock alert card (Faja A-52)
nodes.norm_label: historial home with sin stock alert card (faja a-52)

nodes.label: Wizard Step 4: Que se cobra (charges screen)
nodes.norm_label: wizard step 4: que se cobra (charges screen)

nodes.label: Login screen (Servicios MS, usuario + contrasena)
nodes.rationale: Branded maroon hero with circular MS logo (multimeter motif) over a white card form; single primary 'Entrar' action and password visibility toggle.

nodes.label: Nuevo registro bottom sheet (Trabajo vs Venta de repuestos)
nodes.norm_label: nuevo registro bottom sheet (trabajo vs venta de repuestos)
nodes.rationale: FAB opens a modal that forks record creation into repair/service work (shop or field) versus parts-only sale.

nodes.label: Cambiar contrasena dialog (actual, nueva min 6, repetir)
nodes.norm_label: cambiar contrasena dialog (actual, nueva min 6, repetir)
nodes.rationale: Requires the current password before changing it; new password needs at least 6 characters and confirmation.

nodes.label: Flutter Default Placeholder App Icon
nodes.rationale: Blue Flutter 'F' chevron logo on a white rounded-square macOS tile; this is the unmodified template icon generated by flutter create, meaning the macOS target was never rebranded with the MS logo used on web.

nodes.label: MS Brand Logo (multimeter over MS monogram)
nodes.norm_label: ms brand logo (multimeter over ms monogram)
nodes.rationale: Custom business brand: dark angular 'MS' monogram with a digital multimeter (red/black probes) above it, framed by gold and silver swoosh arcs on a transparent background. The multimeter motif signals an electrical/electronics repair and parts workshop, matching the taller_repuestos (repair shop and spare parts) domain. Maskable variants add safe-zone padding so Android/PWA launchers can crop to circles without clipping the mark.

nodes.label: Web PWA Maskable Icon 192px (MS multimeter logo, padded)
nodes.norm_label: web pwa maskable icon 192px (ms multimeter logo, padded)

nodes.label: Web PWA Maskable Icon 512px (MS multimeter logo, padded)
nodes.norm_label: web pwa maskable icon 512px (ms multimeter logo, padded)

nodes.label: Job construir (analyze, test, build web)
nodes.rationale: Installs libsqlite3-dev because data-layer tests open real SQLite; generates sqlite3.wasm via sqflite_common_ffi_web:setup since it is tied to package version and not versioned; builds with --base-href /taller-repuestos/ because the site lives in a subdirectory.

nodes.label: Workflow: Publicar en Pages
nodes.rationale: Publishes the web build to GitHub Pages on every push to main, gated by analyze+test because once everything compiled but the screen was blank. Concurrency cancels older runs since deploying a stale version is pointless. Web is a preview, not the target.

nodes.label: Tag de test 'capturas' (skip por defecto)
nodes.rationale: Screenshots are PNGs dependent on the generating machine (system fonts, engine version) and would fail elsewhere by one pixel; run manually with --run-skipped --update-goldens.

nodes.label: sqflite_common_ffi_web (SQLite en wasm)
nodes.rationale: Only to test the app in the browser.

nodes.label: Capturas de pantalla (goldens en test/capturas/)
nodes.rationale: analyze and domain tests say nothing about whether the UI looks right; excluded from normal suite because pixel output depends on the generating machine.

nodes.label: .dev/servir.py (servidor con MIME .wasm)
nodes.rationale: python -m http.server serves .wasm with the wrong content type, the browser rejects it and SQLite never starts.

nodes.label: Vista previa en navegador (SQLite wasm)
nodes.rationale: Development preview only: photos and scanner need the phone, and browser data is separate per device.

nodes.label: Tipografia Archivo variable (eje wdth via Tipo/FontVariation)
nodes.norm_label: tipografia archivo variable (eje wdth via tipo/fontvariation)
nodes.rationale: Width axis lets amounts render narrow and heavy like a scoreboard without adding a second font.

nodes.label: Paleta de marca vino #761C1C y oro #87611A, negro como superficie
nodes.norm_label: paleta de marca vino #761c1c y oro #87611a, negro como superficie

nodes.label: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (Archivo Project Authors)
nodes.norm_label: sil open font license 1.1 (archivo project authors)

nodes.label: El correo recupera la contrasena, no decide quien entra
nodes.norm_label: el correo recupera la contrasena, no decide quien entra
nodes.rationale: Offline the only comparison is the local hash; letting the email account lock out the last known password would gain no security (airplane mode bypasses it) and could lock the owner out of his data. Consequence: resetting via email link does not change it on an offline phone.

nodes.label: Funciona sin internet (offline-first, datos en el dispositivo)
nodes.norm_label: funciona sin internet (offline-first, datos en el dispositivo)
nodes.rationale: No server or sync; all data lives on the device. Only optional email password recovery uses the network.

nodes.label: Contrasena de fabrica (sin huella)
nodes.rationale: Only password without a hash; not a secret, and absence of hash signals nobody changed it. Email linking is blocked while it is in use because such an account would belong to anyone.

nodes.label: Tarjeta de atencion del Historial (Hoy toca, Sin cerrar, Sin stock)
nodes.norm_label: tarjeta de atencion del historial (hoy toca, sin cerrar, sin stock)
nodes.rationale: Shows what needs attention, not money (lifetime revenue answers nothing for a solo technician). Empty cards hidden, ordered by urgency; single item shows the name as headline. Chips filter only the list, not the card.

nodes.label: Fechas ISO corto sin hora ni zona horaria
nodes.norm_label: fechas iso corto sin hora ni zona horaria
nodes.rationale: Today is not yet overdue.

nodes.label: Uso con una mano (area tactil minima 44px)
nodes.norm_label: uso con una mano (area tactil minima 44px)
nodes.rationale: Used standing in a workshop or field; no long forms without partial save.

nodes.label: Contrasena guardada como huella PBKDF2-SHA256 con sal
nodes.norm_label: contrasena guardada como huella pbkdf2-sha256 con sal

nodes.label: Recordatorios con intervalo libre en la unidad elegida
nodes.norm_label: recordatorios con intervalo libre en la unidad elegida
nodes.rationale: 'Every 3 months' from Jan 31 lands on Apr 30, not 90 days later.

nodes.label: La sesion dura el dia
nodes.rationale: Stores login date; checked on return from background rather than with a timer, because a timer would log the technician out mid-afternoon with dirty hands.

nodes.label: Stock se mueve al agregar/quitar cada linea
nodes.norm_label: stock se mueve al agregar/quitar cada linea
nodes.rationale: Leaving without saving restores inventory to its prior state.
